q: 1. Half turn stairs are the stairs which change their direction through
explain: Half-turn stairs (like dog-legged stairs) reverse direction by 180 degrees.
Doglegged stairs are a specific type of half-turn stair where the two flights are contiguous with no well-hole between them.

q: 3. While classifying the building, cinema hall should be classified as
explain: Buildings where large numbers of people gather for entertainment or assembly are classified as Public (Assembly) buildings.

q: 4. The sound will be painful to the ear when its intensity exceeds
explain: 130 decibels is considered the threshold of pain for the human ear.

q: 5. The shell roof preferred for industrial roofing is ...........
explain: North light shell roofs are used in factories to provide uniform, glare-free natural light by facing the glazed portions toward the north.
